overview: You opened the book on Saturday's line and did not add another. The share stands at forty-five shillings, with the refusal of a joke still in the line. You did not count the coffer, and you did not write a remainder.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the line, wrote nothing, and shut the book.

parties.name: Gib
parties.context: Lay at the corner of the table while the book was open, and stayed when it shut.
